name: Anthropic Claude API web search tool
description: Provider-hosted web search server tool for the Claude Messages API. One search per use, billed per search.

provenance.notes: Supports version string web_search_20260318 (also 20250305, 20260209), max_uses, allowed_domains/blocked_domains, error codes (too_many_requests, max_uses_exceeded), errors not billed, admin can disable in Console. side_effect read_only is a project classification: the tool only searches. protocol http: server tool executed by Anthropic inside the HTTP Messages API (no client handler).
Supports billing_class metered: $10 per 1,000 searches plus token costs; 'All prices are in USD'.
Supports server-tool classification (runs on Anthropic infrastructure). auth_methods api_key is the Claude API key; the auth mechanism itself was not re-verified on a separate page.
